name: Misa
message: 「I told you I don't have any!? What are you even expecting!?」

name: Misa
message: 「There's no way I'd go out of my way to prep everything yesterday and wake up early this morning just to make chocolate for you!!」

name: Misa
message: 「F-For someone like you... hmph. This much chocolate is plenty.」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Spending money on it would be a waste, so... it's handmade.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey... don't open it right here! N-No!!」

name: Misa
message: 「...G-Geez! Heart-shaped chocolates are way too obvious, it's embarrassing...」
